method: Apply the probe patch on top of the earlier ready8 delta and its single-prefill prerequisites. Both variants use FLASH_VERIFY_READY8=1. In a four-position target verification the candidate may enqueue one more wave of known expert reads after asynchronous Metal submission, while the current demand wave still has untaken experts. Drain in order, retaining the original per-wave width and budgeted store. Fresh single-slot server per run, eight-token warmup, uncached 912-ID handover, 64 real greedy IDs, 8 GiB managed cap and compact DFlash2 depth 3. Clean runs in baseline/early/early/baseline order, 63 client first-to-last intervals per run. Diagnostics in early/baseline order, 24 verified batches per variant, using the expert counters from the rounds experiment. VERIFY_EARLY_WAVES counts additional enqueues across layers per verify; this is an enqueue count, not physical GPU/I/O overlap. OS cache and thermals uncontrolled.
